Kick Back & Relax (Korean: 여름방학에 쉬어가는 법, yoreumppanghage swioganeun bop) is Wind-up Wafflepup's first Costume, released in the first half of The Lost City's New Future update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained through a Pet Costume package in the Package Shop.

Story

One sweltering hot day, Strawberry Crepe Cookie decided to conduct an engineering test for their summer vacation homework. Wind-up Wafflepup followed the young Cookie, thinking it would be a quick and short outing. But alas, the poor Pet ended up totally drained from the heat!

Trivia

  • Kick Back & Relax was released alongside  Endless Summer Fun,  Myth of the Starlit Court,  Little Lifeguard,  Starlit Cheering Squad, and  Rescue Tube.
